OpenLF2

A playable, open-source reimplementation of Little Fighter 2 v2.0a — the same fast, side-view fighting gameplay, with support for mods.

Play in your browser View source on GitHub Download

What you can play

OpenLF2 is under active development. We continue to refine gameplay compatibility with the original game.

Game modes

Versus, Stage, Battle, Championship, Team Championship, and Demo.

Controls

Keyboard and controller play, with touch controls on supported screens.

Music & replays

In-game music, recordings, and replays.

Network play

Network matches between OpenLF2 players over TCP, or through a relay in the browser; original LF2 compatibility is not supported.

Moddable

Gameplay and UI are written in Lua. Mods can extend or replace supported modules through the same versioned script API the base game uses.

MIT-licensed

OpenLF2's code, scripts, and documentation are MIT-licensed. This does not cover the original game, its executable, or its assets.

Play in your browser

This build runs entirely on your device. Press Start game to download the original LF2 v2.0a game data from archive.org (about 30 MB, checked by SHA-256), or select your own LF2_v2.0a.exe or lf2_v20a_Setup.exe installer manually. Your browser saves the installer for future visits; a selected file is never uploaded anywhere.
